conversation.content: Explain how a cache chooses which data to keep. Describe recency and frequency, and give a small example involving repeated document requests. This is an artificial test conversation, not a record from LMSYS.

A recency policy keeps recently accessed data. A frequency policy keeps frequently accessed data. If requests visit A, B, and then A again, A is both the most recently accessed item and the most frequently accessed item in that short history.
Now explain what changes when the cache has room for only two documents and a request for document C arrives.
The cache must make room for C by evicting an existing item. A least recently used policy would evict B in this example.
请解释多轮对话中前缀缓存的工作方式，以及为什么系统提示词、历史消息和当前问题的排列顺序会影响复用。这是一条用于验证数据转换的人工测试样例，不是从 LMSYS 下载的真实对话。
前缀缓存按照完整的有序 token 前缀识别可复用的块。如果开头相同，后续请求可以复用已经生成的前缀。改变系统提示词或者历史消息的顺序，会改变相应位置及其后续块的前缀身份。
如果最后剩下不足一个完整 block 的 token，合成 trace 应该如何记录？
只记录完整 block 的前缀 hash，并保留准确的 token 长度，不把不足一个 block 的尾部补齐后当作完整块。

What is the difference between a real observed arrival timestamp and a synthetic timestamp sampled for a benchmark? Please mention why this distinction matters when interpreting the result. This is an artificial test conversation.

Observed timestamps come from recorded events, while synthetic timestamps come from a model. Benchmark reports should identify which was used so that assumed timing patterns are not mistaken for measurements.
